classification: Original future asset requirements only; zero assets created
synchronization_rule: Any future paired task and scene must share branch IDs, material/state IDs, station IDs, asset IDs, units, gate meanings and a versioned semantic-core digest. Package-level tests must reject drift.

assets.name: Labeled intake rack and protective coupon carriers
assets.geometry_rule: Original generic geometry; carrier dimensions/clearance remain qualified unknowns

assets.name: Four inert target proxies
assets.geometry_rule: Original plain coupons with authored pattern metadata; no traced figure geometry, exact experimental CAD or fabricated nanoscale surface claims
assets.required_semantics: target family, dimensional specification, qualified versus illustrative

assets.name: Sphere-stock and contained assembly station
assets.geometry_rule: Original generic sealed stock bottles and dispensing envelope; no chemical recipe or operational liquid quantities
assets.required_semantics: lot identity, nominal size, containment, unresolved preparation

assets.name: Two SIL-control placeholders
assets.geometry_rule: Distinct source-reported diameter metadata; independently authored optical proxies, not copies of SI photos or exact optical prescriptions

assets.name: White-light microscope station
assets.geometry_rule: Generic original model and state-only control labels; no vendor model export or dangerous optical commands
assets.required_semantics: transmission/reflection, specimen location, objective, focus/reference plane

assets.name: Closed SEM/reference and fabrication service docks
assets.geometry_rule: Generic boxes/receipt interfaces, no internal beam/laser/electrochemical process
assets.required_semantics: job status, document receipts, quarantine and safe-state gates

assets.name: Cross-device coordinate overlays
assets.geometry_rule: Original diagrammatic coordinate frames, not publisher images; object/virtual/detector planes explicitly separated
assets.required_semantics: transform provenance, units, ROI and calibration

assets.name: Read-only evidence dashboard and failure states
assets.geometry_rule: Original authored state machine visualization; no fabricated detector plots
assets.required_semantics: reported, text-only, missing, unrun, quarantined, qualified

assets.name: Closeout and archive objects
assets.geometry_rule: Original generic containment, storage and archive affordances
assets.required_semantics: specimen disposition, raw/derived hashes, service release

source_media_prohibited: Publisher figure pixels, screenshots, crops or textures
Traced figure geometry or reconstructed exact surface from a source image
Publisher or author CAD, source code or raw data packages
nanometer_scale_representation: Use explicit scale metadata and separate illustrative micro/nano inset only when necessary; do not claim a scene proxy resolves 50 nm or physically simulates light.
rendering_boundary: Assets must be clearly illustrative with qualified dimensions only where independently justified; camera-like output requires actual qualified acquisition data, never invented evidence.
geometry_qualification: Unknown specimen exterior dimensions, roughness, masses, optical prescriptions, contact models and collision tolerances are holds, not defaults.
future_tests: No branch silently missing including controls/failures
No unknown physical value replaced by a guess
Native asset metadata sanitized and original authorship documented
